$comment: Machine-readable surface for /apply-pattern. Human spec: patterns/platform-cost-observability/pattern.md. Surfaces the platform's own spend — the WHOLE bill: cloud provider AND per-call vendors (LLM inference, media, email, managed DB) — app-scoped, read-only, in the SaaS admin panel. One invariant REUSES an in-repo cluster (operator plane <- multi-tenant-isolation INV-MTI-004); 002 borrows the deployment-release identity-split discipline without claiming realization; the rest are design-derived and honestly marked — no mined app surfaces platform spend yet (chief-wiggum#229, per the #139 'design-derived statements where not yet built' allowance).
title: Platform Cost Observability
applies_when: the product runs on metered infrastructure and an operator needs to see what THIS app costs — across every vendor — without leaving the admin plane
spend actuals should feed decisions (tier graduation, pricing, unit economics) rather than arriving as monthly invoice surprises
uncapped meters exist (LLM inference, media egress, logging, serverless scale-out) that need budget thresholds alerting out-of-band
components: operator-plane-only-surface: cost routes register only on the admin/operator plane, out-of-band from tenant routes; never reachable by a tenant-scoped principal (reuses the multi-tenant-isolation operator-plane discipline)

per-source-read-only-identity: each externally-read spend source is read with a dedicated credential scoped to viewing billing/usage data only; secret material lives in the secret seam, never env vars (borrows the deployment-release least-privilege identity-split discipline; a distinct identity with a distinct scope)

ingest-then-serve: bounded scheduled ingests persist normalized snapshots; the panel only ever reads snapshots — no request-path call to any billing source, so the monitor's own query spend is bounded by construction, and retained snapshot detail is bounded by a retention/rollup window so its storage cannot become a cost line either

staleness-and-settling-honesty: every figure carries as-of + its source's settling window; settling days marked partial and idempotently re-read/replaced each ingest (fetched sources), estimated lines marked estimated, failed ingest surfaces as visibly stale — never old numbers as fresh

app-scoped-disjoint-sum-preserving-attribution: attribution to this app is established at provision time (dedicated project per app+env, resource labels, per-app vendor keys), never reconstructed by heuristics; breakdowns partition each source's total with explicit unattributed/shared and credit lines; the source set is disjoint (a marketplace/reseller-billed vendor is a sub-line of its billing source, an estimate is superseded by its actual, never summed) and the monthly ledger is reconciled against each settled invoice; billed currency + conversion rate recorded per line

whole-bill-coverage: every metered vendor is a registered spend source (cloud + LLM + media + email + managed DB + processor fees); vendors without a cost API register via app-side metering or operator manual entry (author+time stamped, marked estimated, never clobbered or duplicated by an ingest) — the total is never silently understated

out-of-band-alerts-protected-thresholds: budget thresholds on the cloud bill and the fast-moving vendor meters alert independently of the panel with send-once-per-rung + period re-arm semantics; absence of fresh snapshot data is itself an out-of-band alert (dead-man's switch); threshold config and ingest jobs are protected paths

invariants.$comment: 001 reuses an in-repo cluster (cited in realized_as); 002 BORROWS the deployment-release least-privilege identity-split discipline but is NOT realized by it (INV-DRL-004 proves a deploy identity that cannot read secrets — the spend-reader must read vendor usage APIs, a different identity with its own scope), so it is honestly design-derived like 003-007. This surface is not yet built in any mined app; the cluster grounds when a product first builds it (intended first adopter named in the gcp-serverless-saas binding).

cluster.statement: Operator-plane-only surface: platform spend is cross-tenant operator data; cost routes register only on the admin/operator plane, out-of-band from tenant routes, and are never reachable by a tenant-scoped principal.

Per-source read-only, least-privilege identity: each externally-read spend source is read with a dedicated credential scoped to viewing billing/usage data only — it can neither mutate infrastructure nor billing configuration; its secret material lives in the platform's secret seam, never env vars. Borrows the least-privilege, single-purpose identity-split discipline the deployment-release pattern establishes (INV-DRL-004), but is a distinct identity with a distinct scope — not realized by it.

Ingest-then-serve: the admin panel reads locally persisted snapshots written by bounded, scheduled ingests; no request-path call to any billing source exists. The monitor's own spend is bounded by construction on both axes: query/API cost by the bounded ingest window, and storage by a declared retention/rollup window (raw per-day detail rolls up beyond it) — the cost monitor never becomes a cost line.

Staleness and settling-lag honesty: every surfaced figure carries its as-of timestamp and its source's settling window; days inside the window are marked partial, never final, and for fetched sources each ingest re-reads and idempotently replaces them (keyed on source+day) so late-arriving corrections repair already-persisted days rather than being frozen out at first write; estimated lines are marked estimated, never blended silently into actuals; a failed ingest surfaces as visibly stale, never silently serving old numbers as fresh; and 'final' asserts only that a day has exited its source's declared settling window — never immutability: a correction arriving later (late-metered usage, invoice-time adjustment) reopens and repairs the affected day through the same upsert, leaving a visible correction marker rather than silently freezing or silently rewriting history.

App-scoped, disjoint, sum-preserving attribution: attribution to this app is established at provision time (dedicated cloud project per app+env, resource labels, per-app vendor keys/subaccounts) — the app_boundary provisioning is a protected path — never reconstructed by heuristics over a shared bill; breakdowns partition each source's reported total — unattributable spend lands in an explicit unattributed/shared bucket, credits stay visible as their own line, and each line carries its billed currency plus any recorded conversion rate; the source set is disjoint, counting every unit of spend exactly once: a vendor billed through another source (marketplace/reseller lines on the cloud bill) registers as a declared sub-line of that source, never an independent addend, and an app-side estimate registered as a leading indicator for a source with a reported actual is superseded by the actual on reconcile, never summed with it; at month close the normalized ledger total is reconciled per source against the settled invoice (ledger_vs_invoice_variance).

Whole-bill source coverage: every metered vendor the product depends on is a registered spend source — the cloud provider AND the per-call meters (LLM inference, media delivery, email, managed DB, payment-processor fees); a vendor without a fetchable cost API still registers via app-side metering or operator manual entry — manual figures are operator-authored writes stamped with author and entry time, marked estimated, scoped to sources declaring a manual mechanism, and never overwritten or duplicated by an ingest (the source+day upsert of INV-PCO-004 applies only to fetched sources) — so total platform spend is never silently understated by an invisible vendor.

Out-of-band budget alerts + protected thresholds: budget thresholds on the cloud bill and the fast-moving vendor meters alert through a channel independent of the panel (a breach never waits for an admin to look); each threshold rung fires exactly once per (source, budget period, rung) via a claimed send-once key and re-arms at period rollover — neither spammed into being muted nor latched silent after its first rung; absence of fresh data is itself an alert condition: a snapshot older than its source's staleness_alert_after fires through the same out-of-band channel, so a stalled ingest can never silently mute the meter alerts it computes; threshold config and the ingest jobs are protected paths — an optimization loop may propose changes, never auto-apply them.

spend_sources.description: The registered metered vendors and how each is read: fetch mechanism (billing export / usage API / app-side meter / manual), granularity, settling window, billed currency, and — for a vendor billed through another source — the parent source it is a sub-line of (disjointness, INV-PCO-005). The cloud provider's billing export is the mandatory first entry.

app_boundary.description: How this app's spend is isolated at provision time: dedicated cloud project per app+env, resource labels, per-app vendor keys/subaccounts. Attribution is by construction, never by heuristic; this provisioning is a protected path.

ingest_schedule.description: Cadence of the snapshot ingests (bounds cost_visibility_lag; e.g. daily).

staleness_alert_after.description: Per-source map (source id -> age, with a 'default' key) beyond which a missing fresh snapshot fires the out-of-band dead-man's-switch alert (e.g. default: 2x that source's ingest cadence). A map, not a scalar — sources have different cadences and settling windows.

snapshot_store.description: Where normalized snapshots persist (the app's own DB — the panel never reads a source directly).

snapshot_retention.description: How long raw per-day snapshot detail is kept and the rollup granularity beyond it (bounds the monitor's own storage, INV-PCO-003).

budget_thresholds.description: The threshold ladder per source (cloud budget + vendor meters) that fires out-of-band alerts, send-once per (source, period, rung), re-armed at period rollover.

alert_channel.description: Out-of-band alert delivery, independent of the panel (email/pager seam, not a dashboard).

attribution_labels.description: Resource labels used for breakdown (env / service / tenant), applied at provision time.

reporting_currency.description: Currency the normalized total is presented in; lines keep their billed currency + recorded conversion rate so the total is reproducible.

success_metrics.$comment: Observability health + the feedback edge to the stack cost-tier model and /business-consultant unit economics. Thresholds/ingest are protected paths (INV-PCO-007), so the improvement loop may PROPOSE tuning but never auto-applies.

metrics.desc: share of total spend read from an authoritative vendor-reported source vs estimated/manual lines — the ledger's fidelity, not mere registration (INV-PCO-006)
time from spend incurred to spend visible in the panel (bounded by ingest_schedule + settling windows)
share of total spend in the unattributed/shared bucket (attribution-boundary efficacy)
normalized monthly ledger total vs the settled invoice per source at month close — the ledger's own truthfulness check (INV-PCO-005)
threshold breach to out-of-band alert delivery
the observability machinery's own spend (queries + snapshot storage) as a share of monitored spend (INV-PCO-003)
observed spend vs the stack cost-tier model / unit-economics assumptions — the signal that triggers tier graduation on actuals

protected_paths: the ingest jobs + snapshot write path, including operator manual-entry writes (INV-PCO-003/004/006)
the app_boundary provisioning (dedicated project / labels / per-app vendor keys — INV-PCO-005)
budget threshold config + alert channel wiring, incl. the dead-man's-switch staleness alert (INV-PCO-007)
